amplitude_derivation: 1.1 / (0.82 * 1.75 + 0.4): existing knee limit divided by the frozen policy's maximum loaded-swing request, including the release-gate apex override. Binary64 product is exactly 1.1. No fitted safety margin or changed joint limit.
rule: Multiply the unchanged first-swing smooth amplitude ramp by maximum_amplitude. Full here means full selected amplitude, not unit amplitude. Preserve V28 recovery/stance commands and DLL, zero-phase startup, actual 360-step gait, local-361 contact-gating transition, contact translation, physical model, motor limits, retained horizon and every evaluator. Prefix amplitude remains one. No new feedback, force-aware control, reset, sweep or old-attempt extension.
hypothesis: An in-range knee request should avoid asking the joint to chase an unreachable bend. The same scalar also reduces hip sweep and the associated ideal straight-leg reach loss. A shorter swing may reduce return lag and unintended support loss, but can instead fail to lift or relocate a foot. Only new native data can decide the bounded result. This does not establish the cause of V28's failures.

diagnostic_basis.interval_convention: Walking-local trace start inclusive, landing exclusive. Observation n is carried in command n+1. The final trace has no next command input.
